Steadied after improving on the heels rounding the home turn and again at the entrance to the straight. Not tested over the final stride as the runner in advance shifted out across its running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Prior to the event, the gelding broke through the barrier partition and travelled a short distance before being restrained by its rider. It then underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed fit to race. Shortly after the start was steadied when awkwardly placed near heels. Was held up for clear running rounding the home turn.
